text.tspan: The previous confirmation does not authorize the new price.
Source: UC-30 NF1–7, A1–A4, E1–E2; BR143; §4 Data Integrity

Proposed function-level design derived from the SRS. Class, method, DTO and parameter names may change during implementation. Business behavior, data and branch conditions follow the cited UC / BR / NS requirements. UI messages are translated; SRS message IDs are retained.

Preconditions: valid session, required role, active Student account; JWT authentication under Section 5.2.1. Rechecking and exchange must satisfy NF4–5 and ACID integrity. Transaction boundary includes confirmation-time rechecks and the exchange; failures preserve both balance and ownership. Request-key uniqueness is part of the proposed implementation of UC-30 E2 and the common idempotency requirement.
[retry of the same completed request after a lost response — E2]
[one exchange; ACID and idempotency — Section 4 / UC-30 NF5]
[insufficient coins, ineligible Student, unavailable item or ownership limit exceeded — A2, A4]
16: Show the reason; return to reward
34: Display the existing outcome; do not
44: Display the new price and return to
45: failure: Reject the request; show the
reason and return to reward details /
